Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding the voluntary rating system for child care centers and early education programs.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a quality rating and improvement system; andamending RCW 43.215.100.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.215.100 and 2007 c 394 s 4 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Subject to the availability of amounts appropriated for thisspecific purpose, the department, in collaboration with community andstatewide partners, including the nongovernmental private-publicpartnership created in RCW 43.215.070, shall implement a unifiedstatewide voluntary quality rating and improvement system applicable tolicensed or certified child care centers and homes and early educationprograms. The purpose of the voluntary quality rating and improvementsystem is to give parents clear and easily accessible information aboutthe quality of child care and early education programs, supportimprovement in early learning programs throughout the state, increasethe readiness of children for school, and close the disparity in accessto quality care. Before final implementation of ((the)) a singlestatewide voluntary quality rating and improvement system, the p. 1 SB 5620department shall report to the appropriate policy and fiscal committeesof the legislature. Nothing in this section changes the department'sresponsibility to collectively bargain over mandatory subjects.
